data: For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025, Microsoft reported revenue of $281,724 million (about $281.7 billion) and net income of $101,832 million (about $101.8 billion), according to its fiscal 2025 Form 10-K filed July 30, 2025. Revenue rose from $245,122 million in fiscal 2024, an increase of $36,602 million or about 14.9%. Net income grew from $88,136 million in fiscal 2024, up roughly 15.5%. Diluted earnings per share rose to $13.64 from $11.80. Most of the revenue growth came from Service and Other revenue, which climbed to $217,778 million from $180,349 million. Product revenue edged down to $63,946 million from $64,773 million.
